q.en: You connect to a 300-table SQL Server database but need only 4 tables, with only some columns. Where should you remove the rest?
q.zh: 你连接到一个有 300 张表的 SQL Server 数据库，但只需要其中 4 张表的部分列。应该在哪里移除其余部分？

html.en: Select only the 4 tables in Navigator and remove columns in Power Query
html.zh: 在导航器中只选 4 张表，并在 Power Query 中删除列

why.en: Removing early folds to the source and keeps the model small.
why.zh: 尽早删除可以折叠到数据源，并让模型保持精简。

html.en: Load everything, then hide the unused tables
html.zh: 全部加载，再隐藏没用的表

why.en: Hidden tables still use memory and refresh time.
why.zh: 隐藏的表仍占用内存和刷新时间。

html.zh: 使用视觉对象级筛选器

html.en: Delete the tables in Model view after loading
html.zh: 加载后在模型视图中删除表

why.en: Works, but loads unnecessary data first.
why.zh: 可行，但会先加载不必要的数据。

q.en: A query combines a Private HR spreadsheet with an Organizational SQL source and fails with Formula.Firewall. What is the cause?
q.zh: 某查询合并了一个隐私级别为「私有」的人力资源电子表格和一个「组织」级别的 SQL 数据源，结果出现 Formula.Firewall 错误。原因是什么？

html.en: Incompatible privacy levels between the combined sources
html.zh: 合并的数据源之间隐私级别不兼容

q.en: Which Power Query feature lets you type the desired output for a few rows and generates the transformation for you?
q.zh: 哪个 Power Query 功能让你只需为几行输入想要的结果，就会自动生成转换？

q.en: Column distribution shows 1,000 distinct and 1,000 unique values for OrderID, but profiling is on the top 1,000 rows. What can you conclude about the 5-million-row table?
q.zh: 「列分布」显示 OrderID 有 1,000 个非重复值和 1,000 个唯一值，但分析只基于前 1,000 行。对这张 500 万行的表能得出什么结论？

html.en: Nothing certain; profile the entire data set to check uniqueness
html.zh: 无法确定；要对整个数据集分析才能检查唯一性

html.en: OrderID is unique in the whole table
html.zh: OrderID 在整张表中都唯一

why.en: Only the first 1,000 rows were checked.
why.zh: 只检查了前 1,000 行。

q.en: You must keep only rows from the Orders table whose CustomerID exists in the Customers table. Which merge from Orders?
q.zh: 你只想保留 Orders 表中 CustomerID 存在于 Customers 表的行。从 Orders 进行合并时，用哪种联接？

why.en: That keeps orders with no matching customer.
why.zh: 那会保留没有匹配客户的订单。

q.en: A Sales table has columns Product, 2024, 2025, 2026 (sales per year). You need columns Product, Year, Sales. What do you do?
q.zh: Sales 表有 Product、2024、2025、2026（每年的销售额）列。你需要的是 Product、Year、Sales 三列。怎么做？

html.en: Select Product and Unpivot Other Columns, then rename Attribute to Year and Value to Sales
html.zh: 选取 Product 执行「逆透视其他列」，再把 Attribute 改名为 Year、Value 改名为 Sales

q.en: Which storage mode should you choose for a 50 MB Excel workbook used in a monthly report?
q.zh: 一份每月报表使用 50 MB 的 Excel 工作簿，应选哪种存储模式？

why.en: Small, not real-time: Import is fastest and simplest.
why.zh: 数据小、不需要实时：导入最快也最简单。

why.en: Excel does not support DirectQuery.
why.zh: Excel 不支持 DirectQuery。

why.en: Direct Lake needs Delta tables in OneLake.
why.zh: Direct Lake 需要 OneLake 中的 Delta 表。

q.en: You want to stop a large helper query from being stored in the model while other queries still use it. What do you change?
q.zh: 你希望某个大型辅助查询不被存入模型，但其他查询仍能使用它。要修改什么？

html.en: Clear Enable load on the helper query
html.zh: 取消辅助查询的「启用加载」
取消「包含在报表刷新中」

why.en: The table would still be loaded, just not refreshed.
why.zh: 表仍会被加载，只是不刷新。

html.en: Hide the table in Report view

why.en: Other queries depend on it.
why.zh: 其他查询依赖它。

q.en: Source data has a Date/Time column with seconds, but reports only use the date. What gives the best model size?
q.zh: 源数据有一个含秒数的「日期/时间」列，但报表只用到日期。怎样能让模型最小？

html.en: Change the column to the Date type in Power Query
html.zh: 在 Power Query 中把该列改为「日期」类型

why.en: Far fewer distinct values compress far better.
why.zh: 非重复值少得多，压缩效果也好得多。

html.en: Keep Date/Time and format it as a date
html.zh: 保留「日期/时间」，只把格式设为日期

why.en: Formatting does not change stored values.
why.zh: 格式不改变存储的值。

html.en: Add a calculated column with DATEVALUE
html.zh: 新增使用 DATEVALUE 的计算列

why.en: The original column would still be stored.
why.zh: 原本的列仍会被存储。

q.en: A team must change which database a published semantic model reads from without opening Power BI Desktop. What should the model use?
q.zh: 团队需要在不打开 Power BI Desktop 的情况下，更改已发布语义模型读取的数据库。模型应该使用什么？

html.en: A Power Query parameter for the database name
html.zh: 数据库名称的 Power Query 参数

why.en: Parameters can be edited in the semantic model settings in the service.
why.zh: 参数可在服务中的语义模型设置里编辑。

why.en: What-if parameters create DAX tables for scenarios.
why.zh: 假设参数是为情境分析建立的 DAX 表。

q.en: You combine 24 CSV files from a folder. One file has an extra column. What happens with Combine Files?
q.zh: 你从文件夹合并 24 个 CSV 文件，其中一个文件多了一列。使用「合并文件」会怎样？

html.en: Columns follow the sample file, so the extra column is ignored unless you change the steps
html.zh: 列以示例文件为准，所以除非修改步骤，否则多出的列会被忽略

html.en: Power BI creates a second table
html.zh: Power BI 建立第二张表

html.en: The extra column is appended to every file
html.zh: 多出的列会加到每个文件

q.en: You must create Product and Customer dimensions from one denormalised Sales staging query. Which operation removes repeated product rows?
q.zh: 你要从一个反规范化的 Sales 暂存查询建立 Product 和 Customer 维度表。哪个操作能去掉重复的产品行？

html.en: Keep the product columns, then Remove Duplicates on the key
html.zh: 保留产品列，然后对键执行「删除重复项」

q.en: A connection to Salesforce fails in the service a few months after publishing, while it works in Desktop. What is the most likely fix?
q.zh: 发布几个月后，与 Salesforce 的连接在服务中失败，但在 Desktop 中正常。最可能的解决办法是什么？

html.en: Re-enter (re-authenticate) the data source credentials in the semantic model settings
html.zh: 在语义模型设置中重新输入（重新验证）数据源凭据

why.en: OAuth tokens expire.
why.zh: OAuth 令牌会过期。

why.en: Salesforce is a cloud source.
why.zh: Salesforce 是云端数据源。

html.en: Change the privacy level to Public

html.zh: 改用 DirectQuery 重新发布

q.en: Which statement about a reference query is true?
q.zh: 关于引用查询，哪个说法正确？

html.en: It starts from the output of the original query, so later changes to the original affect it
html.zh: 它以原查询的输出为起点，所以原查询之后的修改会影响它

html.en: It copies all the original's steps and is then independent
html.zh: 它复制原查询的所有步骤，之后彼此独立

why.en: That is Duplicate.
why.zh: 那是「复制」。

html.en: It caches the original's result so the source is read only once
html.zh: 它会缓存原查询的结果，所以数据源只被读取一次

why.en: Each referencing query is evaluated separately.
why.zh: 每个引用查询都会各自计算。

html.en: It can only be used with Import mode

q.en: Sales lines must relate to a Promotions table whose key is PromoCode + Region. What should you do in Power Query?
q.zh: 销售明细要关联到 Promotions 表，而该表的键是 PromoCode + Region。在 Power Query 中该怎么做？

html.en: Add a merged column PromoCode|Region in both tables and relate on it
html.zh: 在两张表中都新增合并列 PromoCode|Region，并以它建立关系
只用 PromoCode 建立关系

why.en: PromoCode alone is not unique.
why.zh: 单靠 PromoCode 不唯一。

html.zh: 把 Promotions 追加到 Sales

q.en: A JSON API returns orders, each with a nested list of order lines. You need one row per order line. Which step?
q.zh: 某 JSON API 返回订单，每个订单都有嵌套的明细列表。你需要每个明细一行。用哪个步骤？

html.en: Expand the lines column to new rows
Extract values with a comma delimiter

why.en: That makes one text value per order.
why.zh: 那会让每个订单变成一个文字值。

q.en: You connect to a Power BI semantic model published by the central BI team and need to add a small Excel table of regional targets. What do you do?
q.zh: 你连接了中央 BI 团队发布的 Power BI 语义模型，还需要加入一张小型的区域目标 Excel 表。怎么做？

html.en: Convert to a composite model (Make changes to this model) and add the Excel table
html.zh: 转换为组合模型（对此模型进行更改），再加入 Excel 表

html.en: Add the Excel data as report-level measures
html.zh: 把 Excel 数据作为报表级度量值加入

html.en: Ask for Write permission on the central model
html.zh: 申请中央模型的写入权限

why.en: That changes the shared model for everyone.
why.zh: 那会为所有人修改共享模型。

html.en: It is impossible with a shared model
html.zh: 对共享模型来说不可能

q.en: A Budget table is at month and product-category level; Sales is at day and product level. How should Budget relate to the model?
q.zh: Budget 表的粒度是月份和产品类别；Sales 的粒度是日和产品。Budget 应如何关联到模型？

html.en: Relate Budget to dimension tables at its own grain (e.g. a Category dimension and a month-level date key), not to Sales
html.zh: 让 Budget 以自己的粒度关联到维度表（例如 Category 维度和月份级的日期键），而不是关联到 Sales

why.en: Fact tables relate to dimensions, never to each other.
why.zh: 事实表只与维度表关联，事实表之间不直接关联。

html.zh: 让 Budget 直接关联 Sales
把 Budget 追加到 Sales

html.en: Use a one-to-one relationship with Product
html.zh: 与 Product 建立一对一关系

q.en: Total Sales shows the same value for every product in a table visual. What is the most likely cause?
q.zh: 在表格视觉对象中，Total Sales 对每个产品都显示相同的值。最可能的原因是什么？

html.en: There is no active relationship between Product and Sales (or it filters the wrong way)
html.zh: Product 和 Sales 之间没有活动关系（或筛选方向错误）

q.en: Which DAX expression returns the number of customers who bought something in the current filter context?
q.zh: 哪个 DAX 表达式返回在当前筛选上下文中有购买行为的客户数量？

why.en: Counts all customers, including those without purchases.
why.zh: 会计算所有客户，包括没有购买的。

q.en: Measure: Sales All Regions = CALCULATE([Total Sales], ALL(Store[Region])). A slicer selects Region = West. What does the measure show?
q.zh: 度量值：Sales All Regions = CALCULATE([Total Sales], ALL(Store[Region]))。切片器选择 Region = West。这个度量值显示什么？

html.en: Sales for all regions — ALL removes the slicer's Region filter
html.zh: 所有区域的销售额——ALL 移除了切片器的 Region 筛选

why.en: That would need ALLSELECTED or no modifier.
why.zh: 那需要用 ALLSELECTED 或不加修饰函数。

q.en: You need YoY growth % for Total Sales. Which pattern is correct?
q.zh: 你需要 Total Sales 的同比增长 %。哪种写法正确？

html.en: DIVIDE([Total Sales] - [Sales PY], [Sales PY]) where Sales PY uses SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR
html.zh: DIVIDE([Total Sales] - [Sales PY], [Sales PY])，其中 Sales PY 使用 SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR

why.en: That is the ratio, not growth, and errors on zero.
why.zh: 那是比率而不是增长，遇到 0 还会出错。

why.en: DATEADD takes a date column, not a measure.
why.zh: DATEADD 的参数是日期列，不是度量值。

q.en: Which is a good reason to use a calculated table?
q.zh: 以下哪个是使用计算表的好理由？

html.en: Creating a date table with CALENDAR when the source has none
html.zh: 数据源没有日期表时，用 CALENDAR 建立日期表

html.en: Storing Total Sales for every product
html.zh: 为每个产品存储 Total Sales

why.en: Use a measure.
why.zh: 应该用度量值。

why.en: Use Power Query.
why.zh: 应该用 Power Query。

q.en: A matrix shows Rank by product. When a user filters to Bikes only, every bike shows rank 1. Which measure fixes it?
q.zh: 矩阵按产品显示排名。当用户只筛选 Bikes 时，每辆自行车都显示排名 1。哪个度量值能修正？

why.en: Ranks each product among the selected products.
why.zh: 在所选产品中为每个产品排名。

why.en: Product is filtered to the current row, so each ranks 1.
why.zh: Product 被筛选到当前行，所以每个都是第 1。

q.en: Customers and Products both relate to Sales with single direction. A slicer on Product must reduce the list in a Customer slicer to buyers of that product. What is the recommended approach?
q.zh: Customers 和 Products 都以单向关系关联到 Sales。Product 切片器必须让 Customer 切片器只显示购买该产品的客户。推荐做法是什么？

html.en: Add a visual-level filter on the Customer slicer: [Total Sales] is not blank
html.zh: 在 Customer 切片器上加视觉对象级筛选：[Total Sales] 不为空

why.en: Achieves the effect without a bidirectional relationship.
why.zh: 不用双向关系也能达到效果。

html.zh: 把两个关系都设为双向

why.en: Works but adds ambiguity and cost to the whole model.
why.zh: 可行，但会给整个模型带来歧义和成本。

html.zh: 把 Customer 合并到 Product

html.en: Use a many-to-many relationship between Customer and Product
html.zh: 在 Customer 和 Product 之间建立多对多关系

q.en: Which function returns the account balance at the end of each month in a matrix by month?
q.zh: 在按月份的矩阵中，哪个函数返回每月月底的账户余额？

why.en: That adds up the month, which is wrong for balances.
why.zh: 那会把整个月加总，对余额来说是错的。

q.en: Your model has its own marked Date table. Model size is larger than expected and there are many hidden LocalDateTable tables. What do you do?
q.zh: 你的模型有自己已标记的 Date 表。模型比预期大，还有很多隐藏的 LocalDateTable 表。该怎么做？

html.en: Turn off Auto date/time for the file
html.zh: 为该文件关闭「自动日期/时间」

html.en: Mark each LocalDateTable as a date table
html.zh: 把每张 LocalDateTable 标记为日期表

q.en: You need to count rows in Sales where Amount is greater than 1,000. Which measure is correct?
q.zh: 你需要计算 Sales 中 Amount 大于 1,000 的行数。哪个度量值正确？

why.en: That returns TRUE/FALSE.
why.zh: 那返回的是 TRUE/FALSE。

q.en: Performance Analyzer shows a measure takes 9 seconds. It uses FILTER(Sales, [Total Sales] > 0) over a 40-million-row table. What is the best first improvement?
q.zh: 性能分析器显示某度量值要 9 秒。它在 4,000 万行的表上使用 FILTER(Sales, [Total Sales] > 0)。最好的第一步改进是什么？

html.en: Filter a column or a smaller dimension instead of iterating the whole fact table
html.zh: 改为筛选某个列或较小的维度表，而不是遍历整张事实表

html.en: Add more visuals to the page
html.zh: 在页面上加更多视觉对象
更改度量值的格式字符串

q.en: Which statement about calculation groups is true?
q.zh: 关于计算组，哪个说法正确？

html.en: They only apply to explicit measures, so implicit measures are discouraged once one exists
html.zh: 它们只作用于显式度量值，所以一旦有计算组就不鼓励使用隐式度量值

html.en: They store results in a table at refresh
html.zh: 它们在刷新时把结果存入表中

html.en: They can only be created in the service

q.en: In Model view, a relationship line is dashed. What does that mean?
q.zh: 在模型视图中，有一条关系线是虚线。这表示什么？

q.en: A measure must return the average of daily sales over the days in the current period. Which DAX?
q.zh: 某度量值必须返回当前期间内每日销售额的平均值。用哪个 DAX？

why.en: Iterates days and averages each day's total.
why.zh: 遍历每一天，对每天的总额取平均。

why.en: That is the average transaction, not the average day.
why.zh: 那是每笔交易的平均值，而不是每天的平均值。

q.en: Which column should be hidden from report view in a well-designed model?
q.zh: 在设计良好的模型中，哪个列应该在报表视图中隐藏？

html.en: Sales[ProductKey], the foreign key to Product

why.en: Users should slice by Product's columns, not the key in the fact.
why.zh: 用户应按 Product 的列切片，而不是用事实表中的键。

q.en: You need to show the share of revenue for 15 product subcategories grouped under 4 categories. Which visual reads best?
q.zh: 你要显示 4 个类别下 15 个产品子类别的收入占比。哪个视觉对象最易读？

why.en: Shows a hierarchy of parts of a whole with many items.
why.zh: 能显示项目众多的部分与整体层次。

why.en: 15 slices are hard to compare.
why.zh: 15 个扇区很难比较。

q.en: A table visual must show a red background when Margin % is below 0, amber up to 10% and green above. Which conditional formatting style fits without writing DAX?
q.zh: 表格视觉对象中，利润率 % 低于 0 时背景为红色，0 到 10% 为琥珀色，高于 10% 为绿色。不写 DAX 的话用哪种条件格式？

why.en: Gradient blends colours rather than using fixed bands.
why.zh: 渐变是颜色过渡，而不是固定区间。

why.en: Needs a column or measure that returns colours.
why.zh: 需要返回颜色的列或度量值。

q.en: A report page must show the top 5 customers by sales and update automatically as data changes. What do you use?
q.zh: 某报表页必须显示销售额前 5 名的客户，并随数据变化自动更新。用什么？

html.en: A Top N visual-level filter on Customer by Total Sales
html.zh: 对 Customer 设置按 Total Sales 的前 N 个视觉对象级筛选

html.en: A basic filter ticking five customers
html.zh: 基本筛选，勾选五个客户

why.en: Fixed names do not update.
why.zh: 固定的名称不会更新。

html.en: Sort the table and resize it to five rows
html.zh: 排序表格并把高度缩到五行

q.en: Selecting a bar in a chart dims the other bars in a second chart instead of removing them. Users want the second chart filtered. What do you change?
q.zh: 在图表中选择一个条形后，第二个图表的其他条形只是变暗，而不是被移除。用户希望第二个图表被筛选。要修改什么？

html.en: Edit interactions: set Filter instead of Highlight on the second chart
html.zh: 编辑交互：把第二个图表从「突出显示」改为「筛选」

q.en: On hover over a country in a map, users should see a small chart of that country's monthly sales. What do you create?
q.zh: 当用户悬停在地图上的某个国家时，应看到该国每月销售额的小图表。应该建立什么？

why.en: Drill-through needs a right-click and opens a full page.
why.zh: 钻取需要右键单击，并会打开整页。

q.en: A report has an Overview page and a hidden Details page. Users should click a button on Overview to go to Details. Which button action?
q.zh: 报表有一个 Overview 页和一个隐藏的 Details 页。用户应点击 Overview 上的按钮前往 Details。用哪种按钮操作？

q.en: A line chart of monthly sales should show the expected range for the next 6 months. What do you add?
q.zh: 每月销售额的折线图应显示未来 6 个月的预期范围。要加入什么？

html.en: A forecast in the Analytics pane, length 6 months
html.zh: 在「分析」窗格中加入预测，长度 6 个月

why.en: A trend line does not project ranges into the future.
why.zh: 趋势线不会推算未来的范围。

q.en: Support wants to know which ticket attributes are most associated with a low satisfaction score. Which visual?
q.zh: 客服部想知道哪些工单属性与低满意度分数关联最大。用哪个视觉对象？

html.en: Scatter chart with a play axis

q.en: Executives open reports on phones. A page looks cramped. What do you do in Desktop?
q.zh: 高管在手机上打开报表。某个页面显得很拥挤。在 Desktop 中应该做什么？

html.zh: 设计该页面的移动布局

q.en: Two pages each have a Year slicer. Choosing 2026 on one page must set the other to 2026 too, and both slicers stay visible. What do you configure?
q.zh: 两个页面各有一个 Year 切片器。在一页选择 2026，另一页也要变成 2026，而且两个切片器都要保持可见。要设定什么？

html.en: Sync slicers with both pages synced and visible
html.zh: 同步切片器，两页都同步且可见

why.en: Users would not see a slicer on the canvas.
why.zh: 画布上看不到切片器。

q.en: Which feature should you use to group customers into segments automatically based on two measures in a scatter chart?
q.zh: 要根据散点图中的两个度量值自动把客户分成几个群体，应使用哪个功能？

why.en: Bins split one column into ranges.
why.zh: 装箱是把单一列切成范围。

q.en: A report page must be printed as a multi-page document with all 5,000 rows of a table. What is the right tool?
q.zh: 某报表页必须打印成多页文件，包含表格中全部 5,000 行。合适的工具是什么？

why.en: Only what fits on the canvas is exported.
why.zh: 只会导出画布上显示得下的内容。

q.en: A user clicks a data point and wants Power BI to suggest which categories explain why sales dropped in March. What do you suggest?
q.zh: 用户点选一个数据点，希望 Power BI 建议是哪些类别导致三月份销售额下降。你会建议什么？

html.en: Right-click the point → Analyze → Explain the decrease
html.zh: 右键单击该点 → 分析 → 解释减少

q.en: Which statement about visual calculations is true?
q.zh: 关于视觉计算，哪个说法正确？

html.en: They are defined on a visual and calculate on that visual's data; they are not reusable in other visuals
html.zh: 它们定义在视觉对象上、基于该视觉对象的数据计算；不能在其他视觉对象中重用

html.en: They are stored in the semantic model
html.zh: 它们存储在语义模型中

q.en: You want Copilot to give a short overview of what data a semantic model contains before you build a report. Which Copilot skill is this?
q.zh: 在制作报表之前，你想让 Copilot 简短概述某个语义模型包含哪些数据。这属于 Copilot 的哪项技能？

q.en: A report's theme must change the default colour of all charts, but one specific chart must stay grey. What do you do?
q.zh: 报表主题要改变所有图表的默认颜色，但某个特定图表必须保持灰色。怎么做？

html.en: Apply the theme, then set the grey colour in that chart's Format pane
html.zh: 套用主题，再在该图表的「格式」窗格中设为灰色

why.en: Visual-level formatting overrides the theme.
why.zh: 视觉对象级格式会覆盖主题。

html.en: Create a second theme for that chart
html.zh: 为该图表建立第二个主题

why.en: A report has one theme.
why.zh: 一份报表只有一个主题。

q.en: Sales reps must see only their region's data in a report shared through an app. You created roles in Desktop. What else is required?
q.zh: 销售代表在通过应用分享的报表中只能看到自己区域的数据。你已在 Desktop 中建立了角色。还需要做什么？

html.en: Add the reps (or their groups) to the roles in the semantic model's Security settings
html.zh: 在语义模型的「安全性」设置中，把销售代表（或他们的组）添加到角色

html.en: Give the reps the Member role

why.en: RLS does not apply to Members.
why.zh: RLS 对成员无效。

q.en: You must test what a user in the "East" role sees before publishing. Where?
q.zh: 发布前你必须测试「East」角色的用户会看到什么。在哪里测试？

html.en: Modeling → View as → East in Power BI Desktop
html.zh: Power BI Desktop 中的 建模 → 以角色身份查看 → East
工作区 → 管理访问权限

q.en: A scheduled refresh of a model that imports from an on-premises file share fails with a gateway error. What should you check first?
q.zh: 某模型从本地文件共享导入数据，其计划刷新因网关错误而失败。首先应检查什么？

html.en: That the gateway is online and the semantic model is mapped to a gateway data source with valid credentials
html.zh: 网关是否在线，以及语义模型是否对应到凭据有效的网关数据源

q.en: An item should be marked as meeting company data quality standards. Only the BI governance team should be able to do it. What do you use?
q.zh: 某个项目要标记为符合公司数据质量标准，而且只有 BI 治理团队能做这件事。用什么？

html.en: Certification, with the governance team set as authorised certifiers by the admin
html.zh: 认证，由管理员把治理团队设为授权的认证者

why.en: Anyone with write permission can promote.
why.zh: 任何有写入权限的人都可以提升。

q.en: Finance wants a PDF of a report page emailed every Monday at 8:00 to the CFO, who already has access. What do you set up?
q.zh: 财务部希望每周一早上 8 点把某报表页的 PDF 邮寄给已有访问权限的财务总监。应该设置什么？

why.en: Alerts fire on a threshold, not a schedule.
why.zh: 警报按阈值触发，不按时间表。

q.en: Which permission must a user have to use Analyze in Excel on a semantic model?
q.zh: 用户要对语义模型使用「在 Excel 中分析」，必须有哪个权限？

why.en: Admin includes it, but Build is the specific requirement.
why.zh: 管理员包含此权限，但具体要求是「生成」。

q.en: A workspace should be usable by viewers with free licences. What must be true?
q.zh: 某工作区要让使用免费授权的读者也能使用。必须满足什么条件？

html.en: The workspace is in a Premium or Fabric F64 (or larger) capacity
html.zh: 工作区位于 Premium 或 Fabric F64（或更大）容量中

html.en: The viewers have the Contributor role

q.en: The marketing department and the sales department must see different reports from the same workspace app. What do you configure?
q.zh: 市场部和销售部必须从同一个工作区应用中看到不同的报表。要设定什么？

html.en: Two workspaces with copies of the reports
html.zh: 两个工作区，各放一份报表副本

why.en: Works but duplicates content.
why.zh: 可行，但会重复内容。

why.en: RLS filters rows, not which reports are visible.
why.zh: RLS 筛选的是行，而不是可见的报表。

q.en: A semantic model needs refreshing every 30 minutes during business hours. The workspace uses Pro licences. What is the issue?
q.zh: 某语义模型在工作时间内需要每 30 分钟刷新一次。工作区使用 Pro 授权。问题在哪里？

html.en: Pro allows at most 8 scheduled refreshes per day; use Premium/PPU/Fabric capacity (48) or DirectQuery
html.zh: Pro 每天最多只能计划刷新 8 次；应使用 Premium/PPU/Fabric 容量（48 次）或 DirectQuery

html.en: Refresh cannot be scheduled during business hours
html.zh: 工作时间内不能计划刷新

q.en: Content exported from a Confidential report must remain protected when emailed outside Power BI. Which feature?
q.zh: 从「机密」报表导出的内容，在 Power BI 外通过邮件发送时必须保持受保护。用哪个功能？

html.zh: 带保护设置的敏感度标签

q.en: Users in an RLS role must not even see that a Salary column exists. What do you use in addition to RLS?
q.zh: 某 RLS 角色的用户必须连 Salary 列存在都看不到。除了 RLS 还要用什么？

html.zh: 为该角色设置对象级安全性（OLS）

html.en: Hide the column in Model view
html.zh: 在模型视图中隐藏该列

why.en: Hidden columns are still reachable by people with Build permission.
why.zh: 有生成权限的人仍能访问隐藏的列。

q.en: A dashboard must show tiles from three different reports built on three semantic models. Is that possible?
q.zh: 某仪表板必须显示来自三份报表、基于三个语义模型的磁贴。这可行吗？

html.en: Yes, dashboards can combine tiles from several reports and models
html.zh: 可以，仪表板能组合来自多份报表和多个模型的磁贴

html.en: No, a dashboard is limited to one report
html.zh: 不行，仪表板只限一份报表
只有使用 DirectQuery 才可以
只有在分页报表中才可以

q.en: You need to move reports from a development workspace to test and then production, comparing differences at each stage. What do you use?
q.zh: 你需要把报表从开发工作区移到测试工作区，再到正式工作区，并在每个阶段比较差异。用什么？

q.en: Which workspace role is the minimum that can publish or update the workspace app by default?
q.zh: 默认情况下，能发布或更新工作区应用的最低工作区角色是哪个？

why.en: Contributors can only if the workspace setting allows it.
why.zh: 参与者只有在工作区设置允许时才可以。

why.en: Only when "allow contributors to update the app" is on.
why.zh: 只有开启「允许参与者更新应用」时才可以。

why.en: Admin can, but Member is enough.
why.zh: 管理员可以，但成员就够了。
